definitions: Either of two small palaces (the Grand Trianon and the Petit Trianon) on the grounds of Versailles, near Paris, France.
A treaty signed in 1920 between the Allies and Hungary, formally ending World War I with regard to Hungary.
examples: The Petit Trianon was a favorite retreat for Marie Antoinette.
The Treaty of Trianon significantly altered Hungary's borders.
